import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static long[][] ncr = new long[40][40];
    static long[][] ans = new long[30][30];

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st;

        // Initialize ans array with pattern
        for (int i = 1; i <= 20; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= 20; j++) {
                ans[i][j] = (i + j) % 2;
            }
        }

        // Compute ncr
        for (int a = 0; a < 40; a++) {
            for (int b = 0; b < 40; b++) {
                if (b > a) ncr[a][b] = 0;
                else if (b == 0 || b == a) ncr[a][b] = 1;
                else ncr[a][b] = ncr[a - 1][b - 1] + ncr[a - 1][b];
            }
        }

        // Read input
        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        long R = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        long C = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        String str = br.readLine();

        long n = R + C;
        long[][] blockarea = new long[(int) n][(int) n];
        long[][] totalarea = new long[(int) (n + 1)][(int) (n + 1)];

        for (int a = 0; a < n; a++) {
            for (int b = 0; b < n; b++) {
                blockarea[a][b] = ncr[a][(int) (R - 1)] * ncr[b][(int) (R - 1)];
            }
        }

        for (int a = 0; a <= n; a++) {
            for (int b = 0; b <= n; b++) {
                totalarea[a][b] = 0;
                if (a == 0 || b == 0) continue;
                totalarea[a][b] = totalarea[a][b - 1] + totalarea[a - 1][b] - totalarea[a - 1][b - 1]
                        + blockarea[a - 1][b - 1];
            }
        }

        long[][] revarea = new long[(int) (n + 1)][(int) (n + 1)];
        for (int a = 0; a <= n; a++) {
            for (int b = 0; b <= n; b++) {
                revarea[a][b] = totalarea[(int) n][(int) n] - totalarea[(int) n][(int) (n - a)]
                        - totalarea[(int) (n - b)][(int) n] + totalarea[(int) (n - a)][(int) (n - b)];
            }
        }

        long d = Math.min(2 * n - 1, n + R - 2);

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        Map<Long, Long>[][] dp = new HashMap[(int) n + 1][(int) n + 1];
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        Map<Long, Long>[][] bp = new HashMap[(int) n + 1][(int) n + 1];

        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                dp[i][j] = new HashMap<>();
                bp[i][j] = new HashMap<>();
            }
        }

        dp[0][0].put(0L, 1L);
        bp[0][0].put(0L, 1L);

        long best = ans[(int) R][(int) C];
        long m1 = (-best + totalarea[(int) n][(int) n]) / 2;
        long m2 = totalarea[(int) n][(int) n] - m1;
        long bestfreq = 0;

        for (int x = 0; x <= n; x++) {
            for (int y = 0; y < n; y++) {
                if (x + y + 1 <= d && str.charAt(x + y) != 'B') {
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : dp[x][y].entrySet()) {
                        long area2 = entry.getKey() + totalarea[(int) n][y + 1] - totalarea[(int) n][y];
                        if (area2 > m2) continue;
                        long prevCount = dp[x][y].getOrDefault(area2, 0L);
                        dp[x][y + 1].put(area2, prevCount + entry.getValue());
                    }
                }
                if (x + y + 1 <= 2 * n - d && str.charAt((int) (n - x + n - y - 1)) != 'B') {
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : bp[x][y].entrySet()) {
                        if (entry.getKey() > m2) continue;
                        long prevCount = bp[x][y].getOrDefault(entry.getKey(), 0L);
                        bp[x][y + 1].put(entry.getKey(), prevCount + entry.getValue());
                    }
                }
            }
            if (x == n) continue;
            for (int y = 0; y <= n; y++) {
                if (x + y + 1 <= d && str.charAt(x + y) != 'A') {
                    long newarea = totalarea[x + 1][y] - totalarea[x][y];
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : dp[x][y].entrySet()) {
                        if (entry.getKey() + newarea > m2) continue;
                        long prevCount = dp[x + 1][y].getOrDefault(entry.getKey() + newarea, 0L);
                        dp[x + 1][y].put(entry.getKey() + newarea, prevCount + entry.getValue());
                    }
                }
                if (x + y + 1 <= 2 * n - d && str.charAt((int) (n - x + n - y - 1)) != 'A') {
                    long newarea2 = totalarea[(int) (n - x)][(int) (n - y)] - totalarea[(int) (n - x - 1)][(int) (n - y)];
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : bp[x][y].entrySet()) {
                        if (entry.getKey() + newarea2 > m2) continue;
                        long prevCount = bp[x + 1][y].getOrDefault(entry.getKey() + newarea2, 0L);
                        bp[x + 1][y].put(entry.getKey() + newarea2, prevCount + entry.getValue());
                    }
                }
                if (x + y + 1 <= d) {
                    dp[x][y].clear();
                }
                if (x + y + 1 <= 2 * n - d) {
                    bp[x][y].clear();
                }
            }
        }

        for (int x = 0; x <= n; x++) {
            int y = (int) (d - x);
            if (y < 0 || y > n) continue;
            for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : dp[x][y].entrySet()) {
                long c = entry.getKey();
                long freq = entry.getValue();
                long c2 = entry.getKey();
                long freq2 = entry.getValue();
                bestfreq += freq * bp[(int) (n - x)][(int) (n - y)].getOrDefault(m1 - c2, 0L);
                if (m1 != m2) {
                    bestfreq += freq * bp[(int) (n - x)][(int) (n - y)].getOrDefault(m2 - c2, 0L);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(bestfreq);
    }
}
